test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Stupendous
solution:
The correct answer is **Stunning**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** synonym for the given word '**Stupendous**' is '**Stunning**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Stupendous**' is '**extremely impressive**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Stunning**' is '**extremely impressive or attractive**'.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate answer is '**Stunning**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Magnifying**- make (something) appear larger than it is, especially with a lens or microscope.

 
 
• **Shining**- giving off or reflecting light; radiant; bright.
 
• **Amplifying**- increase the volume of (sound), especially using an amplifier.
